dossier.headline: Reversible Valley Of Flowers Work Jacket
dossier.summary: A fully reversible cotton work jacket by Ryoko Rain, featuring Valley of Flowers designs on both sides and a faux sherpa collar with brand embroidery. Sold through Complex Shop at $198, it carries brass hardware and a boxy, slightly cropped fit.

facts.label: Collar
facts.value: Faux sherpa with Ryoko Rain embroidery

facts.label: Fit
facts.value: Boxy, slightly cropped with relaxed, elongated sleeves

story.title: Reversible By Design
story.detail: The jacket carries Valley of Flowers designs on both sides and is fully reversible, letting the wearer choose either scenic face.

story.title: Ryoko Rain Detailing
story.detail: A faux sherpa collar features Ryoko Rain embroidery, while brass zipper and button closures complete the work-jacket construction.

story.title: Sold Out At Source
story.detail: A resale listing notes the piece was fully sold out on Ryoko Rain's own website, where it originally listed at $180.

references.title: Reversible Horror Film Work Jacket
references.detail: Ryoko Rain's companion reversible work jacket on Complex Shop, sharing the same $198 price point.

references.title: Complex Shop Outerwear
references.detail: Listed within Complex Shop's outerwear/jackets category alongside other branded and exclusive pieces.

styling: Wear open to reveal the contrasting Valley of Flowers print on the reverse side
Balance the boxy cropped body with relaxed, full-length trousers
Let the elongated relaxed sleeves fall naturally over a fitted base layer

dossier.lookbookStyle: Natural daylight on 35mm film, soft neutral studio and sunlit urban settings, relaxed streetwear mood with slight warm grain.
dossier.lookbookPrompt: A single editorial lookbook sheet in one 3:2 landscape image, arranged as a strict 2x2 grid (2 rows by 2 columns) of four landscape photographs, identical cell sizes, uniform hairline gutters, grid flush to all four edges with no outer margin. Cell 1 (top-left): the Ryoko Rain Reversible Valley of Flowers Work Jacket worn open on a model against a sunlit concrete wall, three-quarter angle. Cell 2 (top-right): close crop on the faux sherpa collar and brass zipper detail. Cell 3 (bottom-left): the jacket shown reversed to reveal the alternate floral face, full torso crop in a neutral studio. Cell 4 (bottom-right): back view of the model walking in an urban street setting. Each product fills about two thirds of its cell; vary pose, crop and angle; all frames share natural daylight 35mm film aesthetic with warm grain. No text, captions, numbers, watermarks, rounded corners or drop shadows.
